title: One More, One Less Worksheets | Kindergarten Math Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: K.CC.A.2, K.OA.A.2

Give your learners extra practice with One More, One Less! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

  • One More Memory

  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
